pricing.title: Plans that fit your workload
pricing.subtitle: Start with {bonus} free credits at sign-up and upgrade whenever you need. Prices in Saudi Riyals.
pricing.checkoutSoon: Checkout opens soon — email us to start now
pricing.creditExamples: A professional product shot ≈ 10 credits · a quick image ≈ 3 · one second of video ≈ 5–12 credits depending on the model. The cost is shown before every generation and only charged on success.
pricing.paymentMethodsList: mada · Visa · Mastercard · Apple Pay — through a payment gateway licensed by the Saudi Central Bank. Your card details never pass through us.
pricing.refundLine: Credits are digital and non-refundable except on technical failure — failed generations are refunded automatically.
